objective: Test H1-H5 individually (never as one combined score) against parameter-matched CNN/ViT baselines, then run the minimum ablation set (D_-complex, D_-prob, D_-graph, D_-topology, D_classical) to identify which components of DIRAC-S's advantage, if any, trace to the architecture versus to explicit auxiliary training signal (L_topology).

H1_probing.result: Robust null for binary classification (tumor volume above/below train-only median) -- all three architectures land near chance (AUROC 0.48-0.55), no significant differences, across linear and nonlinear probes. Continuous log-volume regression recovers real, mostly-significant weak signal (rho~0.15-0.31, R^2~0-0.04) for all three, but per-architecture ranking flips between probe types -- read as noise at n=145, not a reliable ordering.

H2_data_efficiency.result: DIRAC dominates the ENTIRE label-fraction curve, not just the 100% endpoint. AULC (mean of 3 probe-training seeds): dirac=0.7053, cnn=0.5302, vit=0.5432. Margin 0.150-0.180 at every seed.
H2_data_efficiency.status: Strong DIRAC advantage -- but see ablation_disentangling below: this advantage collapses without L_topology.

H3AB_geometry_relations.result: No DIRAC advantage on either geometry (H3-A) or relations (H3-B), robust across 3 probe-training seeds. CNN is tied-to-ahead on H3-A (0.258 vs DIRAC 0.225) and consistently ahead on H3-B (0.214 vs DIRAC 0.147, CNN wins all 3 seeds).
H3AB_geometry_relations.status: H0 (no DIRAC advantage); directly predicts D_-graph should show little effect (confirmed below: partial, not the largest, drop).

H3C_topology.result: DIRAC's C1 (pre-fusion h, mean-pooled, side-channel-free) clearly and consistently beats CNN/ViT: macro-Spearman (mean of 3 probe-training seeds) dirac=0.7113, cnn=0.5647, vit=0.5643, margin 0.123-0.158 at every seed. Sits close to its own C0 sanity-check ceiling (0.7489).
H3C_topology.status: Strong DIRAC advantage -- but see ablation_disentangling below: this advantage collapses without L_topology.

H4_uncertainty.result: S(rho) vs per-token reconstruction error: Spearman -0.669 (strong but backwards -- high entropy predicts LOW error), AUROC 0.159 (well below chance in the intended direction). Reproduces the exact sheaf-project magnitude-conflation failure formalization Section 8 was written against. Partial correlation controlling for ||psi|| collapses toward zero and flips sign (0.153); L2-normalizing psi before entropy collapses the raw correlation from -0.669 to -0.136 -- confirms most of the apparent signal was magnitude, not genuine uncertainty.
H4_uncertainty.status: FAIL -- an actively wrong-signed result, not a null. S(rho) must not appear in any future paper as a working uncertainty signal without this caveat.

H5_robustness.result: No general DIRAC robustness advantage. Architecture-specific, perturbation-specific pattern (all deltas seed-robust, std tiny relative to effect sizes): DIRAC is uniquely least robust to additive Gaussian noise at high severity (delta=0.128 vs CNN~0.000, ViT=0.004); CNN collapses under intensity shift (0.556) and blur (0.460); ViT is most robust to intensity/blur but least robust to partial dropout (0.118).
H5_robustness.status: H0 for general robustness; DIRAC's specific noise-sensitivity flagged as a plausible (not confirmed) link to H4's magnitude-conflation finding.

ablation_disentangling.method: H3-C-style topology probe (single Linear(dim_in,9), MSE, Adam lr=1e-2, 300 epochs) and H2-style nested-fraction data-efficiency curve, re-run against each of the 5 ablation checkpoints using the identical C1 extraction (model.encoder.encode_hidden(x), mean-pooled -- unmodified across all 5 ablations and D_full, since none touch the shared stem+transformer). Single probe-training seed (seed=0) only -- NOT yet checked across multiple probe-training seeds or independently-retrained ablation backbone seeds; both deferred to Phase 6.

D_classical.reading: Collapses to (slightly below) baseline level -- expected floor: no structural branches at all, confirms baselines aren't unfairly weak.

D_-topology.reading: DECISIVE: collapses almost entirely to baseline level (below CNN's 0.5647/0.5302 on both metrics) despite complex/prob/graph branches and L_struct remaining fully intact. Removing only L_topology removes essentially all of H2/H3-C's DIRAC advantage.

D_-complex.reading: Essentially unchanged from D_full (0.7113/0.7053) -- psi's phase content contributes ~nothing to this specific advantage.

D_-graph.reading: Partial, real drop from D_full but stays well above CNN/ViT baseline -- confirms H3-A/B's own prediction that GraphHead's relational mixing contributes something, but far less than L_topology.

D_-prob.reading: Essentially unchanged from D_full, if anything marginally higher on H3-C -- rho's probabilistic/mixture construction contributes ~nothing to this advantage, consistent with H4's finding that rho's entropy signal is itself unreliable.

data_gaps: Ablation disentangling probe used a single probe-training seed (seed=0), unlike H1-H5's 3-seed probe-head checks -- effect sizes here (e.g. D_-topology's ~0.15 gap) are ~10x the seed-to-seed std observed elsewhere, so unlikely to be noise, but not formally seed-checked.

All 5 ablation backbones (like D_full/CNN/ViT before them) were each trained exactly once -- reproducibility across independently-retrained backbone seeds is explicitly Phase 6's job per spec, not attempted here.
H5's Section 21 (distribution shift across genuinely different datasets) remains an unaddressed gap -- no candidate D_B dataset exists in this vault yet.
decision_rule: PASS iff all planned Phase 5 experiments (H1-H5 plus the 5 minimum ablations) ran to completion and were reported individually, with no result suppressed, pooled to hide an unfavorable outcome, or re-run to chase a more favorable number (IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC Anti-goals: 'do not treat H0 as a bug'). Met: H1/H3-A/H3-B/H5 nulls, H4's FAIL, and the ablation collapse are all reported as-is.
interpretation: H1-H5 individually: H1 null, H2 strong DIRAC advantage, H3-A/B null, H3-C strong DIRAC advantage, H4 FAIL (wrong-signed uncertainty), H5 null for general robustness with an architecture-specific noise weakness. The two positive findings (H2, H3-C) were both flagged from the start as confounded with L_topology's explicit training-time gradient into the encoder -- this gate's ablation set was designed specifically to disentangle that. Result: D_-topology (remove only L_topology, keep complex/prob/graph/L_struct fully intact) collapses BOTH H2's AULC and H3-C's macro-Spearman to baseline level, while D_-complex and D_-prob leave both metrics essentially unchanged from D_full, and D_-graph produces a real but partial drop consistent with H3-A/B's own prediction. D_classical (everything stripped) lands at the expected floor. Net: DIRAC-S's entire measured advantage over parameter-matched CNN/ViT baselines is attributable almost entirely to L_topology's explicit auxiliary supervision, not to the complex/probabilistic/graph architectural machinery. The narrower, now-fully-sharpened claim for any paper drawn from this work is 'training with an explicit topology-prediction objective produces strong data-efficient, topology-predictive representations' -- a training-signal finding, not a structured-representation-architecture finding. This is precisely the kind of H0-adjacent outcome Section 32's philosophy commits to reporting plainly rather than working around.
next: Phase 6: multi-seed reproducibility + freeze + paper decision (IMPLEMENTATION_SPEC.md Section 3). Highest-priority items: (1) re-verify D_-topology's collapse and D_full/CNN/ViT's H2/H3-C margins across >=3 independently-retrained backbone seeds, not just probe-head seeds -- this is now the paper's central and most seed-sensitive claim; (2) the same for D_-complex/D_-prob/D_-graph if scope allows; (3) write gate_reports/SUMMARY.md per spec stating plainly that the headline structured-representation hypothesis (H3, general) is NOT supported, and that H2/H3-C's advantage is a training-signal effect -- do not bury this the way covtoken's README does not bury its own falsified hypothesis.
